theme.title: Five on the Floor
theme.subtitle: Teams, stars and stories from across basketball
theme.recap: The best numbers come from all over basketball history. Which answer surprised you most?

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did Charles Barkley's 1992–93 Suns win?
questions.note: 62 wins and the top seed in the West.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: league-best 62–20 record

funFacts.text: Barkley came from Philadelphia in a blockbuster offseason trade.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Suns acquiring controversial All-Star power forward Charles Barkley from the Philadelphia 76ers

funFacts.text: Phoenix moved into America West Arena, which had seating for 19,023.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: their new arena, the America West Arena, which had a seating capacity of 19,023

funFacts.text: The Suns introduced the Streaking Sun logo and new uniforms that season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the logo would be known as the "Streaking Sun" logo

questions.prompt: How many games did the 2002 Kings win at ARCO Arena?
questions.note: 36 home victories in a deafening arena.

funFacts.text: The Kings suffered only five home losses during the season.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Sacramento Kings | 61 | 21 | .744 | – | 36–5

funFacts.text: Their away record was 25–16, substantially less dominant.
Sacramento enjoyed a twelve-game winning streak around the new year.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: posted a 12-game winning streak between December and January

questions.prompt: Willis Reed limped out for Game 7 of the 1970 Finals. How many minutes did he play?
questions.note: 27. He did not leave after his first two baskets, despite the legend.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Contrary to popular lore, he did not sit out after his first two baskets, but remained on the floor for 27 minutes

funFacts.text: Reed's entrance was so improbable because a torn thigh muscle had kept him out of the previous game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Due to a severe thigh injury suffered in Game 5, a torn muscle that kept him out of Game 6

funFacts.text: He made New York's opening two baskets on his first two attempts, electrifying Madison Square Garden.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: he scored the Knicks' first two field goals on his first two shot attempts

funFacts.text: On defense, the injured Reed held Wilt Chamberlain to two makes on nine attempts while he was guarding him.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: limiting him to two shots made in nine attempts

questions.prompt: Across the Raptors' full 2019 title run, how many points did Kawhi Leonard score in the playoffs?
questions.note: 732 playoff points. Kawhi averaged roughly 30 a game across the title run.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Leonard scored 732 points during the 2019 playoffs; this was the third-best scoring total for a single NBA postseason in league history

funFacts.text: Kawhi won Finals MVP for the second time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: He was subsequently named NBA Finals MVP for the second time

funFacts.text: Only Michael Jordan and LeBron James had higher single-postseason totals at that point.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: behind only LeBron James (748, 2018) and Michael Jordan (759, 1992)
